scenes.headline: How Beacon turns finished agent runs into skills
scenes.sub: A decision model grades each trace after the loop, not inside it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Birch! Beacon records what your coding agents do, then asks a decision model which runs are worth learning from.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Grade finished agent runs after the loop, and turn the promising ones into skills.
scenes.say: Most setups put a decision model inside the loop. Beacon puts it after: it grades finished runs offline, and turns the promising ones into skills.

steps.say: Beacon captures sessions from twenty-nine agent harnesses, through hooks, pollers and a browser extension, into one typed event stream.
On command, a finished trace, cut to six fields per event, goes to a decision model with three yes-or-no questions.
The three probabilities are averaged. At zero point six or above, the run becomes a review candidate.
A person approves or rejects each candidate. Nothing in the loop approves on its own.
Approved runs become skill files that future agents load, and their sessions are captured and scored again.

scenes.title: The gate, in one line
scenes.say: The whole gate is one line.

parts.note: did the trace complete the task?
parts.say: Success: did the run complete its task?

parts.note: a correction future agents should reuse?
parts.say: Reuse: is there a correction worth passing on?

parts.note: is that lesson backed by events in the trace?
parts.say: Evidence: do the trace's events back it up?

parts.note: a plain mean and a constant: no answer has a veto
parts.say: It's a plain average against a fixed constant, so no single answer can veto a run.

scenes.title: Two answers are already on record

left.title: Asked of the model
left.say: The model is asked whether the task succeeded, and whether the run holds a correction.

right.title: Already in each event
right.say: But every event records exit codes, actors and approvals exactly, and the projection drops them. Only the reuse question really needs a model.

scenes.text: Let the record answer what it knows exactly; spend the model only on what a regex can't: is this lesson reusable?

scenes.say: To recap: capture everything, grade finished runs after the loop, and let a person decide what becomes a skill.
